text: JavaScript interview fundamentals include scope, closures, hoisting, event loop, promises, async/await, prototypes, this binding, equality, modules, and error handling. Strong answers should explain execution order and trade-offs with a small example.

React interviews commonly cover component rendering, state, props, hooks, useEffect dependencies, memoization, controlled components, reconciliation, keys, context, performance, and state management. Candidates should explain why a pattern is needed rather than only naming an API.

Node.js interviews focus on the event loop, non-blocking I/O, streams, middleware, Express request lifecycle, error handling, authentication, validation, clustering, and API performance. Production answers should discuss timeouts, observability and graceful failure.

MongoDB interviews cover document modeling, embedding versus referencing, indexes, query performance, aggregation, transactions and consistency. Production designs should identify access patterns first and create indexes around real queries.

DSA interview preparation should cover arrays, strings, hash maps, two pointers, sliding window, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, heaps, binary search, recursion and dynamic programming. Candidates should state complexity and edge cases before coding.

System design interviews typically evaluate requirements, capacity estimates, APIs, data model, caching, database selection, load balancing, queues, consistency, availability, observability and failure modes. Start simple and evolve the design as scale increases.

Python interviews cover data structures, comprehensions, iterators, generators, decorators, context managers, exceptions, mutability, shallow versus deep copy, GIL, concurrency and packaging. Good answers include practical use cases and performance implications.

Behavioral interviews are strongest when answered with STAR: Situation, Task, Action and Result. Prepare examples for ownership, conflict, failure, ambiguity, teamwork, leadership, learning quickly and delivering under constraints.
